metadata.methods_description: EEG data were collected using standard electrode montages during both resting-state and task-based conditions. Resting-state recordings captured spontaneous neural activity, while task-based recordings were acquired during cognitive task performance. Raw data were preserved in EEGLAB format (.set/.fdt) to maintain signal integrity. All data are organized according to BIDS standards with accompanying metadata files (JSON sidecars, TSV event files) documenting acquisition parameters, electrode locations, and task event timing. Detailed information about specific task protocols, subject demographics, data collection procedures, and any preprocessing steps is provided in the dataset documentation.
